rag.text:
Test: TC-5564 — Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Inline editing of task on Calendar module
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-66 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamrocket

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Calendar module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-5564 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Inline editing of task on Calendar module
   Expected: Calendar module is displayed. September 2025 is current month. 
TC-5564 Task is visible on the 05/Sep/2025 cell.
2. Click left mouse button on the taskName
   Data: taskName: TC-5564 Task
   Expected: Inline dialog is displayed with following elements:

* Summary: TC-5564 Task
* Progress in %: empty 
* Start date: 05/Sep/25
* End date: 05/Sep/25 
* Assignee: JiraAdmin
* Status: Done
3. Click twice on the Summary, type the textSummary and click Enter
   Data: textSummary: TC-5564 After editing
   Expected: Summary is changed to TC-5564 After editing in inline dialog and on the taskbar on calendar cell.
4. Click twice on the field next to the %, type newValue and click Enter
   Data: newValue: 50
   Expected: 50% is displayed. Progress bar is colored halfway.
5. Click twice on the Start date, select the newDate and click Enter
   Data: newDate: 02/Sep/25
   Expected: Start date is changed in inline dialog and on the calendar. 
Start date of taskbar is 02/Sep/25. End date is 05/Sep/25.
6. Click twice on the End date, select the newDate and click Enter
   Data: newDate: 04/Sep/25
   Expected: Date is changed in inline dialog and on the calendar. 
End date of taskbar is 04/Sep/25. Start date is 02/Sep/25.
7. Click twice Assignee field, type text, click on the newValue and click Enter
   Data: text: Unassigned
newValue: Unassigned
   Expected: Assignee is changed to the Unassigned.
8. Click twice on the Status lozenge, select newStatus from the dropdown and click Enter
   Data: newStatus: In progress
   Expected: Status is changed to In progress in inline dialog. Taskbar is blue.
9. Click outside the inline dialog
   Expected: Inline dialog is closed. All changes remain on the calendar.
